# Pi Quality Gate (`pi-quality-gate`)

Zero-prompt-overhead `Stop` hook static verification gate for Google Antigravity (`agy`), adapted from [`apmantza/pi-lens`](https://github.com/apmantza/pi-lens) and `pi-loops`.

## How It Works

- Runs when the agent finishes a turn (`terminationReason == "NO_TOOL_CALL"`), allowing up to `maxRetries` (default `2`) automatic fix-and-recheck passes via `executionNum` so newly introduced syntax/type errors are caught in the same turn.
- Focuses on **this turn's modified files** via `transcriptPath` + `git status --porcelain` (falling back to transcript file paths in non-Git workspaces), ignoring unrelated pre-existing dirty files unless `scope` is set to `"workspace"`.
- Resolves project-local toolchains (`.venv/Scripts|bin/ruff`, `node_modules/.bin/tsc`) and nearest monorepo subproject manifests (`pyproject.toml`, `ruff.toml`, `tsconfig.json`, `go.mod`, `Cargo.toml`):
  - **JSON (`.json`)**: Validated via `json.loads` (automatically skips JSONC files such as `tsconfig*.json`, `.vscode/*.json`, `plugin.json`).
  - **Python (`.py`, `.pyi`)**: Runs `.venv` or `PATH` `ruff check --no-cache` in each matched `pyproject.toml`/`ruff.toml` directory, falling back to zero-artifact `ast.parse` if `ruff` is missing or times out.
  - **TypeScript (`.ts`, `.tsx`)**: Runs `node_modules/.bin/tsc` or `tsc --noEmit --pretty false` in each matched `tsconfig.json` directory.
  - **Go (`.go`)**: Runs `go vet ./...` in each matched `go.mod` directory.
  - **Rust (`.rs`)**: Runs `cargo check --quiet --message-format=short` in each matched `Cargo.toml` directory.

## Optional Workspace Configuration (`.agents/quality-gate.json`)

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "scope": "turn",
  "maxRetries": 2,
  "timeoutSec": 16,
  "failOnTimeout": false,
  "ignorePaths": ["*.generated.ts", "tests/fixtures/broken_syntax.py", "vendor/"],
  "checkers": {
    "json": true,
    "python": { "enabled": true, "timeoutSec": 8 },
    "typescript": { "enabled": true, "timeoutSec": 12 },
    "go": true,
    "rust": false
  },
  "customCommand": "pytest -q tests/smoke",
  "customCommandExtensions": [".py", ".ts"]
}
```

# Antigravity Pi Plugins (`antigravity-pi-plugins`)

A curated suite of **2 native plugins** for **Google Antigravity (`agy` App & CLI)** ported from standout open-source extensions in the [Pi Coding Agent](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi) ecosystem (`earendil-works/pi` and `apmantza/pi-lens`).

Built with **zero third-party package dependencies**: requires only `Python 3.14+` and `Git` on `PATH`, running identically across Windows (`PowerShell` / `CMD`), macOS, and Linux.

---

## Included Plugins

Each plugin is packaged independently so you can toggle them individually at any time from Antigravity's **Skills & Customizations** panel:

| Plugin | Hooks / Skills | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`pi-guardrails`** | Hook: `PreToolUse` + Skill: `/guardrails` | Blocks writes to secrets/credentials (`.env*`, `.ssh/`, `.git/`, `node_modules/`, `*.pem`, `*.key`), forces confirmation (`force_ask`) on destructive shell/Git commands and protected shell redirections, and supports glob rules & policy validation. |
| **`pi-quality-gate`** | Hook: `Stop` + Skill: `/quality-gate` | Validates turn-modified `.json`, `.py`/`.pyi` (`.venv` or global `ruff` / `ast.parse`), `.ts`/`.tsx` (local `tsc`), `.go` (`go vet`), and `.rs` (`cargo check`) in parallel across subprojects before turn completion with `maxRetries` capping. |

---

## Installation & Removal

### Global Install (`~/.gemini/config/plugins/`)

`install.bat` and `install.sh` dynamically discover plugins under `plugins/*/plugin.json` and pin the detected Python 3.14+ executable in the installed `hooks.json` for fast hook startup:

- **Windows**:
  ```bat
  install.bat                     & rem Install both plugins
  install.bat pi-guardrails       & rem Or install a single plugin
  ```
  To remove: `uninstall.bat` (or `uninstall.bat <plugin-name>`; also supports cleaning up legacy `pi-workflows` / `pi-memory` / `pi-rewind` / `pi-rtk-optimizer` directories).

- **macOS / Linux**:
  ```sh
  ./install.sh                    # Install both plugins
  ./install.sh pi-guardrails      # Or install a single plugin
  ```
  To remove: `./uninstall.sh` (or `./uninstall.sh <plugin-name>`).

### Compatibility with Custom Agents (`minimal-coder`)

- **All Hook features** (`pi-guardrails`, `pi-quality-gate`) operate at the Antigravity engine lifecycle layer and apply **automatically** even to custom agents configured with `excludeDefaultComponents: true`.
- **Skills** (`/guardrails`, `/quality-gate`) load automatically in standard agents; to expose selected skills inside an `excludeDefaultComponents: true` custom agent, list their names under `skills:` in that agent's `agent.md` frontmatter.

---

## Development & Tests

Run the zero-dependency regression suite:

```sh
python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

---

## License & Attribution

Released under the [MIT License](LICENSE). Adapted from [`earendil-works/pi`](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi) (`MIT`) and [`apmantza/pi-lens`](https://github.com/apmantza/pi-lens) (`MIT`). See [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) for detailed attributions.
